# SportsMedia.World

> The digital gateway to sports talent: a grassroots sports media and journalism
> platform connecting student athletes, coaches, schools, and CSR sponsors across
> India. Its mission is to identify, nurture, promote, and empower student
> athletes, PE teachers/coaches, and grassroots sports programs.

SportsMedia.World is a Blue Zone initiative combining a public sports-news
portal with a trainee sports-journalism school and a role-based platform
connecting five kinds of users: trainee journalists (students), coaches,
schools, CSR sponsors, and platform administrators.

## Public content

- [Home](/): overview of the platform, featured athletes, events, and news.
- [About](/about): background on the Blue Zone / SportsMedia.World initiative.
- [Athletes](/athletes): directory of featured grassroots athletes.
- [Events](/events): upcoming and past grassroots sporting events.
- [News](/news): sports journalism articles produced by trainee journalists.
- [Journalism School](/journalism): the sports-journalism training program.
- [Gallery](/gallery): photo coverage from events and academies.
- [Initiatives](/initiatives): CSR and grassroots-development programs.
- [Scholarship](/scholarship): athlete scholarship and sponsorship information.
- [Sports](/sports): sports disciplines covered by the platform.
- [Clubs](/clubs): affiliated clubs and academies.
- [Jobs](/jobs): sports-sector opportunities.
- [Livestream](/livestream) / [YouTube](/youtube): live and recorded match coverage.
- [Contact](/contact): how to reach the SportsMedia.World team.

## Not for indexing

`/login` and everything under `/admin`, `/coach`, `/school`, `/sponsor`, and
`/student` are authenticated, role-specific application dashboards, not public
content. Please do not crawl, index, or summarize them as editorial content.
